activity.notes: Selected mature Russian literary-activity span from Notes from Underground (1864) through Crime and Punishment (1866), The Idiot, Demons, and The Brothers Karamazov (1880). Distinct from 1849 arrest and 1850–1854 imprisonment/exile; no false 1846–1880 uninterrupted writing railway. Some works were written during travels abroad; Russian Empire labels societal/cultural affiliation, not a claim that every day in this period occurred within Russian borders.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica 1911 — Feodor Mikhailovich Dostoievsky
sources.citation_text: Original biographical account distinguishes Dostoevsky's earlier Siberian captivity from his 1860s–1880 mature literary work, including Crime and Punishment.

sources.title: Joseph Frank — Dostoevsky: The Mantle of the Prophet, 1871–1881
sources.citation_text: Scholarly biographical volume details Dostoevsky's final 1871–1881 literary activity and publication of The Brothers Karamazov serial beginning 1879.
